data.description: 开满白色铃兰花的清幽山谷间，丽萨蹲在花丛中，小巧的鼻尖轻轻嗅着花瓣的清香，九条蓬松的尾巴在花海中如浪花般舒展。她采下一朵开得最美的铃兰花捧给你——「铃兰花的花语是‘幸福归来’。博士，愿这朵花能永远带给你好运与快乐！」
data.promptProse: Crouched down in a sunlit mountain valley carpeted with white lily-of-the-valley blossoms, Suzuran wears her moss-green field coat, bucket hat, and canvas backpack as her nine fluffy tails fan out across the bright green grass behind her. She cups a freshly picked white flower stem carefully in both hands and lifts it toward the viewer with a beaming, pure smile. Clear afternoon sunlight bathes the wide flower meadow and casts bright highlights across the delicate bell-shaped petals.
data.title: 铃兰 · 花田铃兰
data.animaCaption: Crouching amid a valley of white lily-of-the-valley blooms in her moss-green field coat, Suzuran holds a picked blossom stem out toward the viewer as her tails spread across the sunlit grass behind her. Bright afternoon daylight fills the open hillside meadow.
